tools.name: estimate_api_cost
tools.description: Estimate the USD cost of an API workload against one catalog model, at its cheapest verified per-token rate. Napkin math - the /calculator page is the full workload estimator.

tools.name: find_models_for_hardware
tools.description: Find which AI models can run locally on given hardware, with a fit verdict and estimated tokens per second. Provide a chip name, or an explicit memory size plus memory type. Same engine as Tokenstead's rig finder.

chip_name.description: Chip name, e.g. 'RTX 4090', 'M5 Max', 'Ryzen AI Max+ 395'

memory_gb.description: Memory available in GB (use with memory_type when no chip_name)

memory_type.description: Memory type when no chip_name given

use_case.description: Rank results for this use case

tools.name: get_model_details
tools.description: Get full details for one AI model by slug: scores, context window, license, local quantized variants with their memory requirements, and cheapest verified per-token API pricing.

tools.name: search_ai_models
tools.description: Search Tokenstead's catalog of AI models (open-weight and cloud). Filter by free-text query, use case, open weights, or a max input price. Returns name, parameter count, context window, license, scores, and the cheapest verified API price per model.

open_weights.description: true = only models with downloadable weights

max_input_price.description: Only models whose cheapest input API price is at or below this USD per 1M tokens

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Tokenstead's published guides (local-AI hardware, model runbooks, cost breakdowns, benchmark reports).
